### 16. unknown-tool-arguments-silently-ignored

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Route | deepen |
| Diagnosis | Anchor `StructuredCallToolFilter.cs:22-28` is now a thin shim; the pipeline lives in `StructuredDispatchPipeline.DispatchAsync` (`StructuredDispatchPipeline.cs:52-166`). Nothing between the LSP normalizer (`:61-66`) and `next(...)` (`:164`) compares `context.Params.Arguments` keys to the tool's advertised `inputSchema.properties`, and the SDK binder drops unmatched keys, so `severty` is lost with no signal. The schemaHint builder (`ToolErrorHandler.cs:496-513`, via `Catalog/ToolParameterIndex.cs:53-94`) runs only on InvalidArgument failures. It keys on `[Description]` params, which diverges from what the SDK binds (the sibling row `workspace-close-schema-leaks-test-seams` has evidence). So it is not a usable source of accepted names. |
| Approach | WARN, don't reject. This is a published contract-care server: rejecting keys it used to accept, or advertising `additionalProperties:false` across 175 SDK-generated schemas, is a breaking wire change that needs an ADR and a major bump. An additive `_meta` field is non-breaking because `MetaSerializer` sets `WhenWritingNull` (`ToolErrorHandler.cs:31-36`). (1) Add a new `Middleware/UnknownArgumentDetector.cs`. It gets the accepted names from `(context.MatchedPrimitive as McpServerTool)?.ProtocolTool.InputSchema` `properties`, falling back to a ToolCollection lookup by name (mirror `StructuredDispatchPipeline.cs:212-217`). Emit `{name, suggestion?}` per unknown key, with the suggestion from a bounded Levenshtein (distance ≤ 2). A schema with no `properties` object yields nothing. Reserved `_meta` and `progressToken` travel in `params._meta`, not in `Arguments`, so they need no special case; assert that in a test. (2) In `DispatchAsync`, run the detector once, right after the normalizer (`:66`) and before recovery or auto-resolution add keys. Set `AmbientGateMetrics.Current.UnknownArguments` and log one warning. (3) Add `UnknownArguments` to `GateMetricsBuilder` and `ToDto` (`AmbientGateMetrics.cs:55-178`). (4) Add a trailing optional `IReadOnlyList<UnknownArgumentDto>? UnknownArguments = null` plus the record and XML doc to `Models/GateMetricsDto.cs:77-89`. The existing `InjectMetaIfPossible` then surfaces it on success and error paths. |
| Scope | Prod 4: `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Middleware/UnknownArgumentDetector.cs` (new), `src/RoslynMcp.Host.Stdio/Middleware/StructuredDispatchPipeline.cs`, `src/RoslynMcp.Core/Services/AmbientGateMetrics.cs`, `src/RoslynMcp.Core/Models/GateMetricsDto.cs`. Tests 1 (new): `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/UnknownToolArgumentWireTests.cs`, mirroring `LspSourceLocationAliasWireTests.cs`. Fragment: `changelog.d/unknown-tool-arguments-silently-ignored.md`. No catalog or README companions: no tool is added and no count moves. Within target; no forcing shape needed. |
| Tool policy | edit-only |
| Estimated context cost | 45000 |
| Risks | Binder key casing: confirm whether the SDK matches argument names case-insensitively. If it does, compare with OrdinalIgnoreCase so a key the binder accepts is not flagged. `MatchedPrimitive` may be null at filter time in SDK 2.2.0; keep the ToolCollection fallback. Detect only on the caller's original args; the recovery re-dispatch (`:206-247`) synthesizes its own. `character` on a tool with no source location is not normalized and correctly reports as unknown. Sibling `workspace-close-schema-leaks-test-seams` removes two schema params; after it lands, callers that pass them get a warning, which is intended. No compile edge. Acceptance bullet 2 (`additionalProperties:false`) is N/A under the warn option. Fanout (shape C, new optional DTO field): `rg -l AutoLoadElapsedMs` finds 1 production construction site (`AmbientGateMetrics.cs:178`), no exhaustive switch, and test round-trips via `builder.ToDto()`. Estimate 4. |
| Validation | `compile_check`. `test_run --filter "UnknownToolArgumentWireTests\|MetaProjectionObservabilityTests\|StructuredCallToolFilter\|StructuredContentWireContractTests"`. Cases: `compile_check{workspaceId, severty:'Error'}` returns `_meta.unknownArguments=[{name:'severty',suggestion:'severity'}]`. The write-tool case is `workspace_close{workspaceId, drainProceses:true}`. A clean call has no `unknownArguments` key. `_meta.progressToken` is not flagged. Then `just ci`. |
| Performance review | Per-call cost: one dictionary-key scan against a cached schema property set. Cache the name sets per tool name. Levenshtein runs only on misses. |
| CHANGELOG category | Fixed |
| CHANGELOG entry (draft) | Tool calls with unrecognized argument names now report them in `_meta.unknownArguments` with a closest-name suggestion. Previously a typo such as `severty` was silently dropped. |
| Backlog sync | Close rows: [unknown-tool-arguments-silently-ignored]. |

### 26. ci-merge-group-validate-support

| Diagnosis | Ruleset 14515474 requires the `validate` context (`strict: false`). `.github/workflows/ci.yml` names `validate-gate` `validate` only for `pull_request` (else `validate-informational`) and has no `merge_group` trigger; `eng/resolve-ci-topology.ps1` `ValidateSet` rejects `merge_group`. Acceptance bullet 5 (enabling the ruleset merge queue) is an operator-approved repo setting applied after this PR merges. |
| Scope | Production files (5): `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `eng/resolve-ci-topology.ps1`, `eng/verify-changelog-fragments.ps1` (review-forced: merge-queue base for the changelog gate), `CI_POLICY.md`, `docs/release-policy.md` (the policy docs are gate-forced: `CiRunnerParityContractTests.ReleasePolicy_StatesTheCanonicalCiTriggerContract` pins the trigger sentence). Test files (2): `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/CiTopologyDecisionContractTests.cs`, `tests/RoslynMcp.Tests/CiRunnerParityContractTests.cs`. Fragment: `changelog.d/ci-merge-group-validate-support.md`. |

Route job passes `github.event_name` through for non-PR events, so `merge_group` reaches the script unchanged. The existing `ValidateJob_GatesStepsOnTheRoutedDocsOnlyOutput` substring assertion still holds. Fanout: none (workflow + script + docs). |
